about.metaDescription: BP Holding is a Saudi partnership delivering integrated engineering, contracting, trade, industry, and services solutions across the Kingdom.
about.title: We're a Saudi holding group built around one promise: integrated solutions, single accountability.
about.lead: Founded in 2021 in Riyadh, Business Pioneers Holding operates across four interconnected sectors — engineering, trade, industry, and services — to deliver value that no single discipline could provide alone.
about.timelineSubtitle: Five years of building infrastructure, partnerships, and an integrated business ecosystem in Saudi Arabia.

y2021.heading: BP Holding founded in Riyadh
y2021.body: The group is incorporated as a partnership headquartered on King Fahd Road, with engineering and contracting as its founding disciplines.

y2022.heading: First flagship project delivered
y2022.body: A mixed-use development is handed over to its owner — combining retail, office, and residential blocks under one masterplan.

y2023.heading: Western region expansion
y2023.body: A Jeddah branch is opened on Al-Tahlia Street to serve clients across the western region of the Kingdom.

y2024.heading: Vertical integration
y2024.body: The group expands into structural concrete works, interior finishing, and engineering consulting — covering every phase of project delivery.

y2025.heading: PEG-N is launched
y2025.body: The Professional Engineers Global Network is launched as an open platform connecting engineering professionals and fostering cross-border collaboration.

y2026.heading: Digital ecosystem launch
y2026.body: A bilingual digital platform unifies the corporate site, RFQ pipeline, contractor onboarding, careers, store, HR portal, PEG-N, and community under one ecosystem.

about.missionBody: To deliver high-quality, fully integrated engineering, contracting, and business solutions that move Saudi Arabia's built environment forward — under a single point of accountability.
about.visionBody: To be the most trusted partner in the Kingdom for clients who refuse to choose between speed, quality, and integrity.
about.leadershipBio: 19+ years of experience in engineering and construction management. Founder of PEG-N (Professional Engineers Global Network), a global platform connecting engineering professionals and fostering collaboration worldwide.
about.sectorsSubtitle: We don't pick one — we coordinate all four under one operating model.
about.sectorTradeBody: Smooth and efficient trading operations across material categories.
about.sectorIndustryBody: High-quality production and continuous, flexible support.
about.sectorServicesBody: Integrated services that bind the other three sectors together.
